name: Improved Toughness (Monster)
body:
The monster is much hardier than most of its kind.

Prerequisite: 2 or more racial hit dice, Toughness

Benefit: The monster gains 1 additional hit point per 2 hit dice.

Special: This feat may be selected more than once. Its effects stack.
